diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says SCL, datasheet reading says CLK-OE
diffs.evidence: Ordering-only difference, same seven pins with the same functions. The Soldered 333051 board has two separate headers on opposite edges, with no shared pin 1: the official pinout image (v1.3.0) shows CLK-OE, CLK-OUT, INT top to bottom on the left-edge 3-pin header and SCL, SDA, VCC, GND top to bottom on the right-edge 4-pin header. The schematic (HEADER_MALE_3X1 K2: CLK_OE, CLK_OUT, INT; HEADER_MALE_4X1 K5: 5V(VCC), SCL5, SDA5, GND) agrees. The model lists the 4-pin header first (SCL, SDA, VCC, GND), then the 3-pin header (CLK-OE, CLK-OUT, INT). The second reading lists the 3-pin header first. Each header's order matches the silkscreen in both readings, and the part description says the headers sit on opposite edges.
